problem_type: Electron user-visible errors bypass the desktop translation boundary
symptom: A batch of Electron throw and dialog messages appears only in Chinese even when the desktop locale is English; the i18n baseline records these unlocalized literals.
direct_cause: Selected Electron production paths constructed user-visible Error and dialog text directly from CJK literals instead of calling desktopT with paired zh-CN/en keys.
class_root: The desktop-visible error boundary was not applied consistently across provider adapters, media validation, workflow import, review, and custom-call paths, leaving each caller to choose whether to localize its own message.
affected_population: English-locale users receiving validation or provider-adapter errors
Users importing ComfyUI workflows or decomposing image layers
Users running Runway or custom-call requests and media technical checks
entry_points: Browser media validation and prompt-image size errors
Image layer decomposition and technical review details
internal_only_reason: This batch applies Nomi's existing desktopT translation contract to internal Electron error and dialog boundaries; no external API contract decides the locale behavior.
invariants: Selected Electron user-visible throw and dialog messages are emitted through desktopT.
Every added desktop key has both zh-CN and en values with matching interpolation names.
The electron i18n baseline shrinks and is never widened or bypassed by an exclusion.
generality_proof: The selected entries cover independent provider, media, workflow, review, and custom-call callers, and every one now converges on the existing desktopT boundary; the existing check:i18n shrink-only gate catches future direct CJK literals or key drift.

recurrence.reason: This is a bounded inventory burn-down of existing literals, with no new runtime boundary or parallel implementation introduced. The existing check:i18n gate already prevents adding new Electron baseline entries, while this batch removes the selected legacy instances.
same_class_scan: Ran check:i18n before the batch: 146 Electron occurrences across 39 files.
Selected 62 user-visible throw/dialog occurrences across independent audio, browser media, provider adapter, workflow, decomposition, review, and custom-call paths.
Ran check:i18n after the batch: 84 occurrences across 28 files; no exclusion list or baseline expansion was used.
Checked the selected source files for direct CJK Error/TypeError literals with the changed static regression test.

legacy_paths.rationale: No parallel translation implementation or fallback was added; each selected literal was replaced in place by the existing desktopT boundary.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The change uses Nomi's existing translation helper and does not change a third-party dependency or runtime lifecycle.

migration: Existing saved projects and provider configurations are unaffected. The only migration is at source level: selected generated error text now resolves against the current desktop locale.
residual_risks: 84 Electron baseline occurrences remain for later batches; they remain protected by the shrink-only gate and were intentionally not disguised as exclusions in this commit.
